title: bl_procs.fresh_pids takes any transcript of the process's working-directory project as proof its session is at work, so an orphaned claude process in a busy checkout is called detached
goal: bl_procs.fresh_pids counts a claude process fresh only by a transcript that process can have written (not one last written before the process started), so a leftover claude process in a checkout where other sessions write stays an orphan in procs, selfcheck and the sessions panel

run: import os, sys, tempfile, time; T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.environ["CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"] = T; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import bl_procs, kbusage; cwd = os.path.join(T, "checkout"); os.makedirs(cwd); base = kbusage.config_dir() / "projects" / kbusage.project_name(cwd); base.mkdir(parents=True); f = base / "other-session.jsonl"; f.write_text("{}\n"); now = time.time(); os.utime(f, (now - 100, now - 100)); procs = [{"pid": 9, "comm": "claude", "start": now - 30}]; got = bl_procs.fresh_pids(procs, {9: cwd}, now); print("fresh:", sorted(got)); sys.exit(0 if not got else 1)

repro_reason: the fix needs a way to tie a process to its own session, which the repro cannot plant; this plants the one case no binding can excuse: a transcript last written before the process started
